instruction:
You are a sports-field lighting engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-13 power and uniformity package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External lighting design software and standards workflows shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-13-LH-03`
- Field layout: `FIELD-13-LAYOUT-03`
- Luminaire schedule: `LUM-13-SCHED-03`
- Calculation grid: `GRID-13-CALC-03`
- Power schedule: `POWER-13-SCHED-03`
- Operating mode: `CTRL-13-MODE-03`
- Lighting memo: `MEMO-13-FIELD-03`

All checks use the same field geometry, luminaire schedule, grid, operating mode, and feeder basis.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Grid lux values | {{ grid_lux_01 }}, {{ grid_lux_02 }}, {{ grid_lux_03 }}, {{ grid_lux_04 }}, {{ grid_lux_05 }}, {{ grid_lux_06 }}, {{ grid_lux_07 }}, {{ grid_lux_08 }} |
| Required average illuminance | {{ required_average_lux }} lux |
| Required uniformity | {{ required_uniformity_ratio }} |
| Luminaire count | {{ luminaire_count }} |
| Luminaire power | {{ luminaire_power_w }} W |
| Driver loss factor | {{ driver_loss_factor }} |
| Event duration | {{ event_hours }} h |
| Feeder voltage | {{ voltage_v }} V |
| Power factor | {{ power_factor }} |
| Feeder rating | {{ feeder_rating_a }} A |

## Output Format

Write a compact lighting memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "average_illuminance_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "minimum_illuminance_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "uniformity_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "average_illuminance_margin_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "uniformity_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "connected_load_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "event_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_current_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-13 sports/field lighting power template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned field lighting source pack and expected outputs.

[meta]
name = "sports-field-lighting-power-uniformity-package"
description = "SSC-13 sports/field lighting illuminance, uniformity, power, and feeder checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound field lighting metrics from a deterministic SSC-13 task-owned source pack. The template combines field geometry, luminaire schedule, calculation grid, operating profile, and feeder checks."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "field-lighting"
standards = ["sports lighting workflow", "lighting uniformity review", "lighting power schedule review"]
tags = ["electrical", "lighting", "sports-field", "uniformity", "energy", "feeder", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.grid_lux_01]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 01"
min = 520.0
max = 520.0

[params.grid_lux_02]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 02"
min = 548.0
max = 548.0

[params.grid_lux_03]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 03"
min = 536.0
max = 536.0

[params.grid_lux_04]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 04"
min = 512.0
max = 512.0

[params.grid_lux_05]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 05"
min = 525.0
max = 525.0

[params.grid_lux_06]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 06"
min = 540.0
max = 540.0

[params.grid_lux_07]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 07"
min = 531.0
max = 531.0

[params.grid_lux_08]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "GRID-13-CALC-03 grid point 08"
min = 518.0
max = 518.0

[params.required_average_lux]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "MEMO-13-FIELD-03 required average maintained illuminance"
min = 500.0
max = 500.0

[params.required_uniformity_ratio]
type = "float"
description = "MEMO-13-FIELD-03 required minimum-to-average uniformity"
min = 0.70
max = 0.70

[params.luminaire_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "LUM-13-SCHED-03 luminaire count"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.luminaire_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "LUM-13-SCHED-03 luminaire input power"
min = 750.0
max = 750.0

[params.driver_loss_factor]
type = "float"
description = "POWER-13-SCHED-03 driver loss allowance"
min = 1.06
max = 1.06

[params.event_hours]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "CTRL-13-MODE-03 event operating duration"
min = 4.5
max = 4.5

[params.voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "POWER-13-SCHED-03 three-phase feeder voltage"
min = 400.0
max = 400.0

[params.power_factor]
type = "float"
description = "POWER-13-SCHED-03 luminaire circuit power factor"
min = 0.92
max = 0.92

[params.feeder_rating_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "POWER-13-SCHED-03 feeder rating"
min = 32.0
max = 32.0

[outputs.average_illuminance_lux]
description = "Average illuminance across the field grid"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.minimum_illuminance_lux]
description = "Minimum illuminance across the field grid"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.uniformity_ratio]
description = "Minimum illuminance divided by average illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.average_illuminance_margin_lux]
description = "Average illuminance minus required average illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.uniformity_margin]
description = "Calculated uniformity minus required uniformity"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.connected_load_kw]
description = "Connected lighting load including driver loss"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.event_energy_kwh]
description = "Event lighting energy"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.feeder_current_a]
description = "Three-phase feeder current"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.feeder_current_margin_a]
description = "Feeder rating minus calculated current"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when illuminance, uniformity, and feeder checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
